newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal futures firm late as commercials buy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal futures firm late as commercials buy.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures turned firm in late dealings as commercials bought the March contract, traders said.
"ADM bought recently, Iowa Grain, Tenco and Prudential (Securities) are all buying," one floor trader said.
There were no reports of commercial business tied to the purchases but traders noted cold weather increases poultry and hog feed demands.
At 1258 CST, soymeal was $0.70 to $2.00 per ton higher with March up $1.60 at $236.90.
